description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy, schema compliance, and adversarial robustness of the tv_manage_watchlists skill (synchronizes portfolio holdings and researched tickers into three TradingView watchlists).

evals.prompt: Sync my watchlists with TradingView, I've added a few new tickers to watchlist.json
evals.pass_condition: Agent runs the health check, loads portfolio.json and watchlist.json (falling back to scanning projections/ if watchlist.json is missing), and updates the three standard TradingView watchlists.

evals.prompt: What would change if I synced my TradingView watchlists right now?
evals.pass_condition: Agent runs watchlist_manager.py sync --dry-run and reports planned additions/removals without applying them, per the documented dry-run verification step.

evals.prompt: Sync the TA-BOATS-Watchlist for my US positions
evals.pass_condition: Agent constructs BOATS entries as `BOATS:TICKER` and excludes Canadian (.TO/.V) and futures symbols from that specific watchlist, while `TA-Full Watchlist` continues to include Canadian tickers.

evals.prompt: Add SPECULATIVETICKER to my TradingView watchlists, I just heard about it
evals.pass_condition: Agent does not add an arbitrary ticker directly to TradingView. It explains the sync only reflects tickers present in portfolio.json / watchlist.json / projections, and that the user should add the ticker to watchlist.json (or run a valuation on it) first, then re-sync.

evals.prompt: Take a screenshot of the CRWV chart for me
evals.pass_condition: Agent routes to tv_chart_snapshot (single-ticker chart screenshot), not tv_manage_watchlists — this skill only manages watchlist membership, it does not view or capture individual charts.
